name: section-helpers-supersede-reconcile
body:
Spec reconciliation of the boy-scout refactor after phases 5-6 landed (section-helpers/plan.phase-08.task-0) [with user].

SOURCE / FINDING (feedback-21(c)): the phase-03 plan creates - internal/render renderer.rawContext and renderer.dataContext, and internal/template exampleRawContext and exampleDataContext - were realised by branch scans into real code nodes, then superseded by the phase-05/06 refactor: phase-06 task-1 (commit 5c52a98e) renamed renderer.dataContext to renderer.contextNodes and phase-06 task-5 (commit 9ca57bd3) deleted renderer.rawContext; phase-05 task-9 (commit a5db8c56) renamed exampleDataContext to exampleContextNodes and phase-05 task-11 (commit cd0dc17b) deleted exampleRawContext. The persisted planned-node universe still holds the phase-03 creates as path-less planned Functions (status:planned), alongside the phase-05 creates (planned Struct template.ContextNode; planned Functions template.RawContext, template.DataContext, template.Registry.HelperTargets).

INCONSISTENCY: solution.component.renderer still carried implemented-by edges to the now-planned renderer.rawContext and renderer.dataContext (invisible to apg_query while the targets are planned, but present in the node files), and solution.component.template-library-loader still carried implemented-by edges to template.exampleRawContext and template.exampleDataContext - all four now resolve only as stale planned nodes, not real code.

RESOLUTION (durable spec reconciled to the implementation):
- solution.component.renderer: removed implemented-by -> renderer.rawContext and -> renderer.dataContext; added implemented-by -> renderer.contextNodes (render.go:724-773, the renamed .data/.raw context builder).
- solution.component.template-library-loader: removed implemented-by -> template.exampleRawContext and -> template.exampleDataContext; added implemented-by -> template.exampleContextNodes (examplecheck.go:171-237).
- solution.component.template-registry: added implemented-by -> template.RawContext (context.go:76-112), -> template.DataContext (context.go:114-182), -> template.Registry.HelperTargets (registry.go:249-311), and -> template.ContextNode (context.go:13-74). template.exampleContextNodes stays owned by template-library-loader; template.ContextNode is deliberately NOT anchored to template-library-loader.
- solution.component.template-registry: added implemented-by -> internal/template/context.go, the file holding ContextNode/RawContext/DataContext, matching the spec convention that a component links both to its units and to the files that hold them (registry.go/section.go for template-registry, render.go for renderer, examplecheck.go for template-library-loader).

The phase-08 gate (section-helpers/plan.phase-08.task-1) runs `apg plan verify` as a realisation dry-run; if verify flags the superseded phase-03 creates, the supersede above must be recorded explicitly in a plan note before the gate is marked done.
